topic: Open Oscar Server: open-source server compatible with AIM and ICQ clients
headline: Open Oscar Server Breakthrough
caption: Just came across the trending Hacker News story about the Open Oscar Server. As a full stack dev, I find it incredible how open-source projects can revive legacy protocols like AIM and ICQ with modern tech stacks. It’s a reminder of how powerful community-driven efforts are in keeping old-school protocols alive and adaptable to today’s security standards. I’m intrigued to see how this project manages scalability and integration challenges. This could open doors for retro-compatible, privacy-focused messaging apps. Definitely a project worth tracking! 🚀 #OpenSource #MessagingProtocols #FullStackEngineer #TechTrends #RetroMessaging
